about.title: About
about.lead: ArchAI is a platform for creating a house plan online.
about.body:
Someone about to build a house usually does not know exactly what they want: how many rooms, what size, roughly what it costs. ArchAI is for that stage: you enter the dimensions and within seconds get a finished plan, a 3D view and an indicative estimate. You can edit the plan yourself — add and remove rooms, move walls.

Plans are not taken from a template library. Every plan is computed from your parameters: the outline is split recursively, rooms are placed, circulation is carved, doors and windows are positioned. So identical requests give identical results, and different requests give genuinely different houses.
about.disclaimer: ArchAI plans and estimates are for initial orientation. They are not approved design documentation and do not replace a building permit. Verify everything with a licensed architect and structural engineer before building.
